items.title: Nippon Columbia malware incident exposes 8.6 million karaoke fan records
items.detail: Daiichi Kosho, a major Japanese entertainment system maker, disclosed that a malware infection at its contractor, Nippon Columbia, exposed more than 8.7 million customer and employee records. [...]
